note: Disposition of investigated repair tasks (issue #7 process). States: OPEN, EVIDENCE_ADDED (a measured source now lifts the input out of UNKNOWN/MISSING but it is NOT verified), BLOCKED (precise blocker + evidence), REPAIRED_VERIFIED (status reached VERIFIED through recorded evidence; none yet). Entries are append-only; a state is checked against the regenerated engine output by tests.

NFL:nfl.pace.found: game and team totals are priced from the market-implied centre plus a historical residual bank; pace/EPA/QB/script/q_scoring identifiers do not appear in the pricing path | TESTED on GAME totals only (research/audit/verification/NFL_totals_incremental.json): over 1,615 out-of-sample games (2020-2025, expanding window by season) no feature group (pace, EPA/efficiency, explosiveness, pass-rate/script, rest/context, realised QB change, all) was DEMONSTRATED to improve on the near-close market total after week-cluster bootstrap, Bonferroni, both halves and leave-one-season-out; point estimates are mostly positive but their intervals are wide (cannot exclude gains of ~1-2% of MSE)
NFL:nfl.pace.remaining: design choice (market-as-prior, author-reported OOS reliability slope 1.01); team totals, quarters and halves are UNTESTED; the line is a near-close consensus (not point-in-time) with no Kalshi price baseline for these seasons; QB information tested only as the REALISED starter
NFL:nfl.pace.next: ablation of pace/EPA/QB features on the residual of the market centre, with the market line as the baseline (needs the prospective ladder history on nfl-edge-finder@market-data)

NFL:nfl.ratings.found: alpha_engine/lab/ratings.py + game_lab.py compute opponent-adjusted rolling team ratings (EPA, success, explosive, tempo; half-life {4,8,16}, carry {0.4,0.8}, adjust on/off) from free nflverse play-by-play, strictly pre-game (state written before the game updates it). 13,362 ledgered walk-forward experiments (research/audit/lab/ledger_*.jsonl.gz): ratings beat climatology out of sample (2022-24 totals +0.046 log-score, game CI above zero) but show NO advantage over Kalshi prices (totals +0.0016 [-0.015,+0.019]; spread/moneyline worse).
NFL:nfl.ratings.remaining: Not VERIFIED collection: nflverse assets are unpinned latest releases (per-refresh sha256 only). No L3/L4 evidence of a gain over the market.
NFL:nfl.ratings.next: Prospective 2026 test of the frozen strict point-in-time model (research/prospective/nfl_totals_v1, claim gate in alpha_engine/lab/prospective.py); pin nflverse release assets.

NFL:nfl.script.found: Game-script inputs (predicted margin, total, team points) are produced by the market-free game lab and used by the player lab (player_run.build_game_ctx); never prices. Their predictive contribution to player props was ledgered (research/audit/lab/ledger_player_*.jsonl.gz).
NFL:nfl.script.remaining: No in-game script simulation; the inputs are pre-game point estimates only. Player-prop probabilities remain worse than the market (best declared variant: pass yds -0.014 CI includes 0, others CI below 0).
NFL:nfl.script.next: Evaluate the declared player variant v3_listed_emp prospectively as a separately labelled, market-selected-population experiment (research/prospective/nfl_player_v3).

NFL:nfl.qb.found: The lab's `qb` group uses the REALISED starting quarterback (partial point-in-time). Removing it (plus observed weather) from the totals model lowers 2022-24 log-score gain +0.046 -> +0.023 but keeps parity with the market (+0.0012), so the prospective model drops it.
NFL:nfl.qb.remaining: No free, timestamped pre-game expected-starter source is collected (depth chart / inactives lack publication times in nflverse).
NFL:nfl.qb.next: Collect expected-starter and official inactives with publication timestamps prospectively; then re-test the qb group point-in-time.
